page.notes: The poem is an acrostic on the initials S P E N G (Speng), with the initial letters printed large at the left margin; the initial letters are joined to their lines as printed. The last word "Lam-" is a line-end hyphenated word that continues on the next page. The decorative rule is a printer's ornament, not text.
